children.desc: An impression is counted each time your promoted product is shown. Impressions help you understand how often your product is being seen.The impression of the campaign during startDate-endDate.String type..If the value is '-', it means no data.

children.name: clicks
children.desc: Clickthrough rate (CTR) is the ratio showing how often people who see your promoted product end up clicking on it. It’s calculated as Clicks divided by Impressions.The click of the campaign during startDate-endDate.String type..If the value is '-', it means no data.

children.name: ctr
children.desc: Clickthrough rate (CTR) is the ratio showing how often people who see your promoted product end up clicking on it. It’s calculated as Clicks divided by Impressions..If the value is '-', it means no data.

children.name: cpc
children.desc: The cost-per-click (CPC) is the average amount you pay each time someone clicks your promoted product. It’s calculated as Spend divided by Clicks..If the value is '-', it means no data.

children.name: storeUnitsSold
children.desc: The total number of units sold after the shoppers click on your promoted product during the selected date range..If the value is '-', it means no data.

children.name: storeOrders
children.desc: The total number of orders from your store during the selected time period, after someone clicks on your promoted product..If the value is '-', it means no data.

children.name: storeRevenue
children.desc: Total store revenue is generated from the units sold in your store after buyer(s) click your promoted product(s). It is the total amount paid by the buyer plus all discounts applied, store credit, shipping fees, and surcharges.

children.name: storeRoi
children.desc: The store's return on investment (ROI) shows how efficient your Sponsored Discovery's spend is in driving revenue for your store.
